title: BIM, digital twin, drawings & common data environment

evidence.note: BIM area is an informational panel stating IFC/glTF/LOD are not built; no backend
Only settings, projects, rfis, submittals, change_orders, sov_lines, audit_events; no model/drawing/document tables
Spec states CAD conversion, geometry and IFC import not yet built

items.gap: No IFC parser, no model storage, no semantic GlobalId capture or geometry validation.
items.codePartNow: Tenant-scoped schema, API routes, workflow logic and tests in the isolated enterprise_suite schema.
plan: Add append-only migration apps/api/drizzle/00NN_cc161.sql creating enterprise_suite tables for IFC 4.3 import pipeline with org_id, revision, timestamps and RLS policies mirroring 0005_enterprise_suite.sql.
Add Drizzle definitions in new file apps/api/src/db/schema/enterprise_cc161.ts and export from schema/index.ts (existing tables unchanged).

Create isolated module apps/api/src/modules/enterpriseCC161/ with zod-validated routes using requireOrg/tenantTx/assertCan, the enterprise settings gate and a per-feature flag via modules/flags; write audit events on every mutation.
Register the plugin in apps/api/src/modules/registry.ts as a new entry beside enterprise.
Add a web panel under apps/web/src/features/enterprise/ shown only when the flag is on; keep the existing InfoPanel copy when off.
Rollback: turn the flag off; tables stay in place, no data deletion.
testsToAdd: apps/api/src/modules/enterpriseCC161/cc161.int.test.ts: cross-org access returns 404, flag-off returns 403, happy path persists and audits, stale If-Match revision rejected.
Unit test of the core logic for IFC 4.3 import pipeline against fixture inputs.
items.acceptance: With the flag on for a test org, integration tests pass and "Parse vendor-neutral model data with semantic identity and geometry validation." is exercised against fixtures; with the flag off, existing enterprise routes and UI behave unchanged.
items.securityNotes: New tables need org_id with RLS and route-level assertCan; parse untrusted uploads (IFC/BCF/ZIP/point clouds) in a sandboxed worker with size and zip-bomb limits. Never fabricate geometry, measurements, permit status or engineering approval.
